questions.stem: In knee arthroscopy, patients are usually ____ than joint replacement patients.

Knee EUA with or without washout can be done under which anaesthetic alone?
options: General anaesthesia with a laryngeal mask

questions.stem: Why are nerve blocks of limited use for knee arthroscopy?
questions.answer: Long duration, and they fail to cover the thigh tourniquet site.

questions.stem: What premedication is given before knee arthroscopy?

What low dose of IV ketamine has been suggested to improve analgesia in knee arthroscopy?
In knee arthroscopy day cases, why should IV morphine be avoided if possible?
questions.answer: High rate of postoperative nausea and vomiting (PONV).

questions.stem: What analgesics are used to discharge patients after knee arthroscopy?
After knee arthroscopy, what volume of 0.5% bupivacaine do many surgeons inject into the joint?

After knee arthroscopy, what effect do nerve blocks have on postoperative mobilisation?
options: They have no effect on mobilisation
